items.title: Lactose‑free Greek yogurt with berries & oats
items.method: Stir oats into yogurt, top with thawed berries. Eat cold.

items.title: Whole‑grain toast + almond butter + banana
items.method: Toast bread. Spread almond butter. Top with banana slices.

items.title: Chickpea salad wrap (tuna‑free)
items.method: Mash chickpeas with lemon and LF mayo/yogurt. Fold in celery. Wrap in tortilla.
